_doc: Developer Device Platform (DDP) catalog ids -> this repo's phones, for android/ddp/run_ddp.py (bench matrix --ddp <id>). An id is a pool, not a unit: each job of a session may land on another physical phone and firmware build, so every record names the unit it ran on (conditions.ddp / device.ddp: ro.build.fingerprint, ro.serialno). scheduleKey = the key of ops/dashboard-v1/schedule.json devices that exclude-on= rows name, and the source of the CPU mask (that device's cpu_mask: pixel8a f0, s26 none); null = no schedule device: no mask, and every row with an exclude-on= is skipped (ddp-device-key-unknown). display = the phone's name for the plan; product = ro.product.device. Catalog ids read with `gcloud beta device-run devices list` (2026-10-15, LANE.md §0).
